followups.body:
Follow-up from #454. This work is blocked until the parent's reviewed evidence packet merges.

Review exactly the six Vanuatu province IDs below. Government's Department of Local Authorities confirms the six-province tier and island groups; the current retained boundary derivation is OSM/Wambacher 2017 (ODbL), and the administrative source registry's byte hash differs from the retained pinned GeoBoundaries distribution. The OCHA/Pacific Community ADM2 area-council layer is a neighboring-tier reference (66 features; license metadata blank), not an authoritative province outline. Repository-helper WGS84 source-edge screens show Jaccard 0.936–0.981 against current Atlas shapes; this does not settle which geometry is correct or prove island completeness.

Acceptance: reconcile the distribution and source hashes, source vintage/derivation and ODbL duties; verify exact boundary authority and island coverage for each unit or state why it is unavailable; compare neighboring granularity; classify each subject; record evidence hashes, restoration and limitations; produce evidence-quality manifest and positive/negative controls; obtain distinct exact-head substantive review; submit one focused PR through the serialized merge queue.
